title: Knight of the Pinecones
description: A surreal knight in a white helmet and black armor bursts from a large blue shield adorned with golden pinecones and a heraldic crest. The knight points forward as white liquid splashes dramatically, set in a vibrant field of white lilies, purple lavender, red poppies, and golden elephants carrying a yellow banner reading 'FORCE'.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a knight in white helmet and black armor exploding out from a large blue heraldic shield decorated with multiple golden pinecones, pink and yellow mantling, the knight pointing forward with white liquid splashing, standing in a meadow filled with white lilies, lavender, red poppies, and several ornate golden elephants marching, one carrying a tall yellow banner with the word FORCE in black letters, dramatic sky, detailed digital painting
